name: Sad news makes Boop sad and keeps it so, until it's taken back
case: No agent is working. The person tells Boop their dog died this morning: Boop turns sad at once, with a sad or hurt face. Half a minute later they say they miss him so much, and Boop stays sad: more sad news is no reason to cheer up. Then they laugh that they were only kidding and the dog is fine, and Boop's mood switches straight away, out of sad to calm or happy, with a face that isn't sad.
